quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson and Matas Buzelis discuss their upcoming rookie season expectations
quotes.excerpt: I don't know, I'm just going to like sit back and vibe. Just with the flow.

quotes.social_post: Caleb Wilson and Matas Buzelis are keeping it light at Bulls media day as they prepare for their rookie season. Wilson says he is just going to sit back and vibe with the flow.

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson on his excitement for his rookie season with the Bulls
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited to be here and I feel like it's going to be great for me.
quotes.quote: It's been really exciting. Just getting started now, but I'm excited to be here and I feel like it's going to be great for me to kind of see what I have to offer and really excited for the year.
quotes.social_post: Caleb Wilson says he is excited to get started with the Bulls and see what he has to offer during his rookie season.

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson on the surreal feeling of starting his NBA career
quotes.excerpt: It kind of feels surreal, but it's here now, so I'm excited for it.
quotes.quote: It kind of feels surreal, but it's here now, so I'm excited for it. Training camp starting tomorrow, so it's all just coming at me fast, but I'm really excited to be here and excited to be a Bull.
quotes.social_post: It is all coming fast for Caleb Wilson as training camp begins. He says the start of his NBA career feels surreal but he is ready to be a Bull.

quotes.speaker: Caleb Wilson
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson on his upcoming NBA debut at the United Center
quotes.excerpt: It's my first time getting in an NBA game and playing in the United Center.
quotes.quote: In two weeks, we'll be tipping off and it'll be real. It's my first time getting in an NBA game and playing in the United Center and hopefully I'll be here for a really long time. I know all the nerves and stuff will go away once the ball gets tipped up in there.
quotes.social_post: Caleb Wilson is looking forward to his first NBA game at the United Center in two weeks. He says he knows the nerves will go away once the ball gets tipped up.
